description.zh:
新的加速域名。

仅支持添加主域名，例如`example.net`。
description.en:
The new accelerated domain name.

Only primary domain names are supported, such as `example.net`.

description.zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：**cn-hangzhou**。
description.en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.
The accelerated domain name that you want to update.

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于修改加速域名。修改后的新加速域名部署在中国内地时，必须已完成ICP备案。

**UpdateDomain**接口不支持在同一个账号下并发修改加速域名。
descriptions.en:
This operation is used to update an accelerated domain name. If the new accelerated domain name is deployed in the Chinese mainland, the domain name must have obtained an ICP filing.

The **UpdateDomain** operation does not support concurrent updates of accelerated domain names within the same account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga update-domain --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --target-domain example.com --domain example.net --region cn-hangzhou
